source.title: Effects of Fhb1, Fhb2 and Fhb5 on Fusarium Head Blight Resistance and the Development of Promising Lines in Winter Wheat

quote: The development of Fusarium head blight (FHB)-resistant winter wheat cultivars using the gene Fhb1 has been conducted in northern China. Sumai 3, a Chinese FHB-resistant spring wheat cultivar, carries three FHB resistance genes: Fhb1, Fhb2 and Fhb5.
note: The source explicitly names the gene as an FHB resistance gene; ASR/APR/quantitative is not stated in this sentence.

source.title: Rpp1 Encodes a ULP1-NBS-LRR Protein That Controls Immunity to Phakopsora pachyrhizi in Soybean

quote: Phakopsora pachyrhizi is the causal agent of Asian soybean rust. ... Rpp1 is unique among the Rpp genes in that it confers an immune response (IR) to avirulent P. pachyrhizi isolates.

source.title: Functional Analysis of the Asian Soybean Rust Resistance Pathway Mediated by Rpp2

quote: Asian soybean rust is an aggressive foliar disease caused by the obligate biotrophic fungus Phakopsora pachyrhizi. ... The soybean Rpp2 gene confers resistance to specific isolates of P. pachyrhizi.

source.title: The Soybean Rpp3 Gene Encodes a TIR-NBS-LRR Protein that Confers Resistance to Phakopsora pachyrhizi.

quote: Soybean rust is an economically significant disease caused by the fungus Phakopsora pachyrhizi ... seven genetic loci (Rpp1 to Rpp7) that provide race-specific resistance to P. pachyrhizi (Rpp) have been identified. Rpp3 was first discovered and characterized in the soybean accession PI 462312 (Ankur)

source.title: Identification and analyses of candidate genes for rpp4-mediated resistance to Asian soybean rust in soybean

quote: Asian soybean rust is a formidable threat to soybean (Glycine max) production in many areas of the world ... Rpp4 was previously identified in the resistant genotype PI459025B and mapped within 2 centimorgans of Satt288 on soybean chromosome 18 (linkage group G).

source.title: Discovery of a seventh Rpp soybean rust resistance locus in soybean accession PI 605823

quote: A novel Rpp gene from PI 605823 for resistance to Phakopsora pachyrhizi was mapped on chromosome 19. ... A novel resistance gene, Rpp7, was mapped to a 154-kb interval

source.title: The requirement of multiple defense genes in soybean Rsv1-mediated extreme resistance to soybean mosaic virus

quote: Soybean mosaic virus (SMV) is a major viral pathogen of soybean. Among the three SMV resistance genes, Rsv1 mediates extreme resistance (ER) against most SMV strains

source.title: Isolation and validation of a candidate Rsv3 gene from a soybean genotype that confers strain-specific resistance to soybean mosaic virus

quote: Rsv3, which confers strain-specific resistance to SMV, was previously mapped between the markers A519F/R and M3Satt in chromosome 14

source.title: Identification of haplotypes at the Rsv4 genomic region in soybean associated with durable resistance to soybean mosaic virus

quote: The Soybean mosaic virus (SMV) resistance locus Rsv4 is of interest because it provides a durable type of resistance in soybean [Glycine max (L.) Merr.].

source.title: A single-nucleotide insertion in Rxp confers durable resistance to bacterial pustule in soybean

quote: KEY MESSAGE The soybean Rxp gene, encoding a bHLH transcription factor and an ACT-like domain, has an rxp allele producing a truncated protein that confers resistance to pustule-causing Xanthomonas axonopodis pv. glycines.

source.title: Pinpointing Rcs3 for frogeye leaf spot resistance and tracing its origin in soybean breeding

quote: Frogeye leaf spot is a yield-reducing disease of soybean caused by the pathogen Cercospora sojina. Rcs3 has provided durable resistance to all known races of C. sojina since its discovery in the cultivar Davis during the 1980s.
